title: With acquisitions off the table and iPhone sales stalled, analysts now say Apple is preparing a massive stock buyback program (AAPL)
text: With acquisitions off the table and iPhone sales stalled, analysts now say Apple is preparing a massive stock buyback program (AAPL) By Jim Edwards Apr 5, 2018, 6:33 am 5 pts iPhone sales are going nowhere. Apple VP Eddy Cue says the company won't be doing any major M&A. So how will the company keep investors interested in its stock? Analysts think the company could add another $100 billion to its stock buyback program. On Apple's next earnings call, scheduled for…
